name: PotatoVoxel
description: PotatoVoxel (fork of Dramatic Shape): the overworld as a 3D voxel diorama, retuned for low-end devices. Same diorama, with the settings that would otherwise cost a handheld its frame budget: one quality ladder (VOXEL OFF / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / POTATO = 100% / 75% / 50% / 33% render scale, sub-native rungs folded back with ordinary canvas filtering), every quality knob pre-pinned, disk mesh cache. Desktop HIGH keeps the full two-layer actor shadow map; MEDIUM and lower use contact/blob actor shadows. The full desktop mod is one env var away (DS_BRICK=0).
